evidence.title: react-bits — a Claude Code skill for React Bits

name: react-bits
summary: Claude Code skill that pulls real React Bits component source from the live registry instead of recalling it from memory.
description: A Claude Code skill for adding React Bits components to a project. Instead of recalling component code, it fetches the real source and dependencies from the live registry, backed by a catalog of 165 components that is auto-updated daily and a script that writes the fetched files to disk. Install through the Claude plugin marketplace; the repo's own code is MIT.
contains: fetches real React Bits component source and dependencies from the live registry
catalog of 165 components with 4 variants each, auto-updated daily
script (rb-add.mjs) writes fetched files to disk
installs through the Claude plugin marketplace
repo code is MIT; component source is fetched under React Bits' own license
